title: Chiefs Narrative — 2026 Week 12 · Preview
body:
Automated refresh of the Chiefs Narrative and 2026 slate.

**Minus-3 in Buffalo, with Walker out and Johnson carrying**

- Regenerated data/narrative.json + archive: last-game review (ESPN recap + wire), current state / work list, and next-game plan + matchup, plus the live schedule, news wire, model projection, Vegas line and prediction markets.
- Wrote data/schedule_2026.json from ESPN (kickoffs in CT, networks, venues, final scores when ESPN has them).
- Re-rendered the X's-and-O's diagrams.

## Dropped sentences

Fact-check salvage removed these lines. Automerge is held.

- ```
Mahomes at 120.0, Kelce with six catches for 74 yards and two touchdowns, including the 22-yard score at Q2 1:54
```

Generated by the Chiefs Narrative (daily) workflow.

Draft for human review. Approve any waiting pull_request workflow in Actions, then require the real gates check. Promote validated develop to main through a reviewed PR; pages.yml deploys main. Review editions still require Karen's signed PASS.

No third push. ## R2-N2d residual (disclosed) The `.github/` / `tools/` automerge guard is **authoritative only in edition-qa.yml** (base YAML on `pull_request_target`). `ci.yml`'s automerge job YAML is taken from the **promote PR head**, so a promote that edits `ci.yml` can remove ci.yml's own guard. Tracked in https://github.com/stevologic/arrowheadpaesanowebsite/issues/426. **Required row:** `R2-N2d` executes edition-qa.yml's real gate step against a promote that edits `ci.yml`'s automerge job; edition-qa **REFUSES** (`.github/`). That is the base-YAML job holding the line. ## Bootstrap (unchanged) **Nov 27 promote is a hand merge. L1 is the first automerge.** This fix must land on develop, then a human promote of the tools/ change to main. ## Per-id map (authoritative FROZEN-38 r2 list) Format: frozen id → pytest/unittest node
